purpose: Additional external workload after manuscript review; fixed before inspecting WISDM raw values or test results. Local protocol, not an external preregistration.
dataset: WISDM Activity Prediction AR v1.1, official provider archive
split: test subject_id % 6 == 0; validation subject_id % 6 == 1; training remaining IDs; no participant overlap
selection: validation macro-F1; ties choose lower alpha; transform biases fit training only; refit scaler and ridge on training+validation, keep transform fixed
scaling: raw acceleration; StandardScaler(with_mean=False) on feature matrix; no per-window input normalization
parsing: Split observations on semicolons or line breaks, trim whitespace and trailing empty fields. Require six fields, finite axes, subject 1..36, known activity, integer timestamp >=0. Invalid observation breaks a segment. Segment on subject change or a >1e9 ns positive gap between two positive consecutive timestamps. Retain repeated, backward and zero timestamps in original file order; count all such events, do not sort or resample. Do not segment on activity labels. Drop segments shorter than W. Labels are endpoint labels. These are file-order segments at nominal 20 Hz, not certified uniformly sampled continuous recordings.
timing: same M4, one thread, N/E/T/H, full pipeline through predictions. All retained test recordings, warm each path and verify features before timing. Three sequential fresh processes, three rotated repetitions per record; median of sums within process, median across processes. No other experiments concurrently.
report: Both hops and every comparator, whether favorable or not. Exact feature and prediction comparisons, per-record times, participant totals, six-class confusion, macro-F1, fit-set majority baseline. This extends one feature family, not an architecture-independent claim.
amendment_reason: Format/time-quality pilot, before any test inference: 11733 otherwise usable rows have a trailing comma, one missing terminator joins two physical lines, repeated/nonincreasing timestamps caused 1033401 accepted observations to fall in sub-W segments. v1 fit completed; no test inference or timing had run. Preserve full v1 audit. Same split/model/window/hop choices.
